gaps.detail: the filter on "occ" meets "hospital" on products, which the filter's own list offers no choice for; it is not written as terms

choice "sub" is an on/off switch that multiplies the price by 0.9; when on, the shopper also picks "freq" (2, 4): WooCommerce core holds no recurring or price-changing switch (a recurring order needs WooCommerce Subscriptions or an equivalent plugin); recorded, not built
the shopper picks the amount paid (£15, £25, £40): sold as one variation per amount; redeeming it later as store credit needs a gift-card plugin, which WooCommerce core does not have

no choice that creates variations ("amount") is one of Google's variesBy axes (color, size, material, pattern, suggestedAge, suggestedGender), and SGS's product preflight publishes a variable product only when one of its variation terms maps to one (no_variesby); the product is made and kept a draft
